note: Parke County (IN) has no queryable zoning district service found. The county GIS portal parkein.wthgis.com is a web map viewer with no public ArcGIS REST services (/arcgis/rest/services returns 404). The county planning office publishes the zoning ordinance as a PDF; no zoning district polygon layer or ArcGIS service was found for the county or its towns (Rockville, Rosedale, Montezuma etc.). ArcGIS searches for Parke County zoning returned nothing relevant; Rockville's code links only to text and a zoning map table, not a queryable map.
